resource_profile.memory_cap: not separately enforced; exact-rational bit/operation/wall caps apply
resource_profile.retry_policy: No cap or serialization-limit changes under this profile. A further change requires a new profile version.
resource_profile.scope: Shared common-tube predicate and replay for the same selected archived R3 proof. Does not rerun or alter the R3 native evaluator.
resource_profile.selection_binding: reuse the first frozen R3 record ID and its exact semantic/line hashes; no outcome-based reselection
resource_profile.version_reason: Same numeric and serialization limits as v3. Separates the radius-expansion adapter work from common-check replay work, then reparses the exported segment before checking so the stored work record can be independently replayed.

quantifiers.coefficient_representation: named outer interval hull; interval arithmetic may forget rational-map correlations but does not resample a physical label
